task.body:
## Problem
`build_conversation_markdown` (`app/conversation_memory/report.py`) de-duplicates sources across the report but not within one message, so a message citing the same source twice renders `- Sources: [Source 1](#source-1), [Source 1](#source-1)`.

## Required behaviour
- Within one message, each source index appears at most once, in first-seen order.
- The example renders `- Sources: [Source 1](#source-1)`.
- Distinct sources still render in order: `[Source 1](#source-1), [Source 2](#source-2)`.
- Report-level numbering and the source list are unchanged; existing tests are unchanged.

## Scope
Allowed paths:
- `app/conversation_memory/report.py`
- `tests/test_calyx_conversation_current_main_714.py`

Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_calyx_conversation_current_main_714.py`
- `python -m ruff check app/conversation_memory/report.py tests/test_calyx_conversation_current_main_714.py`
- `python -m ruff format --check app/conversation_memory/report.py tests/test_calyx_conversation_current_main_714.py`

New tests must cover:
- a duplicate source within one message;
- two distinct sources keep their order.

OC-SWARM-CAPABILITY: open-ended-code-authoring
OC-SWARM-WRITES: repo-global
